target.claim: Recover a reusable TRUE-side mechanism from the 12 released residuals without identifiers, answer lookup, stored certificates, stored equation tables, or a new proof representation.
target.primary_metric: new official Lean 4.32.2 acceptances within the 120-second solver boundary
secondary_metrics: zero Lean rejections among promoted candidates

verifier.internal_success: target-root equality plus independent replay_dag acceptance

strongest_existing_route.separator_intervention: budget only; 30 then 60 seconds with all other limits frozen
strongest_existing_route.why_first: This route produced the three newly official residual proofs and remains the strongest unexplored existing closure mechanism.

live_rivals.H_search_resource: The existing route can solve some residuals when given more search time; no new capability is needed.
live_rivals.H_selection_memory: The proof is reachable, but current age/goal selection fails to choose the necessary clauses within budget.
live_rivals.H_closure: The necessary distinction already exists in accumulated closure but is not composed into the target recipe.
live_rivals.H_constructor_language: An internal proof is found and replayed but cannot be compactly or correctly emitted to Lean.
live_rivals.H_capability: The existing inference and closure operators cannot construct the required proof even with the frozen extended budget.
live_rivals.H_measurement_infrastructure: Observed failure is caused by timeout accounting, judge infrastructure, or logging rather than mathematical search.
live_rivals.H_leakage_surrogate: Any apparent gain depends on IDs, labels, exact surface forms, public-answer memory, or a released-set surrogate.

separator.inputs: The 12 released residual equations, selected only by the frozen IDs above; answer fields are removed before the runner receives them.
separator.intervention: Run the frozen existing route at 30 and 60 seconds per row; record found, replay, root match, proof nodes, certificate bytes, search counters, exhaustion, and elapsed time.
controls: alpha-renamed copy of every internal success
operation-dual copy of every internal success
FALSE controls sampled without labels before execution
unchanged 788/800 baseline regression after any proposed promotion
separator.resource_budget: At most 60 seconds per residual-route execution in this separator; no parameter grid and no new primitive.

outcome_to_action.60_second_gain: Diagnose search/resource or selection; optimize scheduling under 120 seconds before considering new representation.
outcome_to_action.internal_success_lean_failure: Diagnose constructor/language; repair emitter without changing search.
outcome_to_action.no_internal_success: Map clause frontier and inspect existing closure before proposing a new operator.
outcome_to_action.surface_control_failure: Reject as leakage or representation dependence.
outcome_to_action.false_control_true_candidate: Reject immediately as a soundness failure.
outcome_to_action.unexpected_pattern: Preserve as a new residual and do not force it into a frozen rival.

promotion_gate.complexity_rule: Retain the smallest causal change; do not add a primitive unless the separator falsifies existing-route explanations.
